title: Tab Bar Navigation — Structure & Selected States

raw.file_name: Tab Bar Navigation — Structure & Selected States

comments.author: design-forge
comments.text: Late-sprint update: I've been exploring a gesture-based navigation pattern in the Forge v2 component file as an alternative to tab bar. Initial user testing shows experienced users prefer swipe navigation. This is exploratory only — not requesting a change to the current sprint's work.

comments.author: carlos-mendez
comments.text: Noted — we'll evaluate for a future sprint. Tab bar (PR #22) is going in as planned. The gesture nav exploration is interesting but it's a post-launch consideration. We'd need fresh user testing with a broader sample before reversing the current architecture.

title: Offline Mode — UX States and Sync Indicator

comments.author: design-forge
comments.text: Offline mode UX states designed: (1) Offline banner at top of task list, (2) Sync in progress indicator on app foreground resume, (3) Conflict toast for server-wins resolution. Consistent with the sync strategy Carlos confirmed in Slack.

comments.author: carlos-mendez
comments.text: These states match exactly what I'm implementing. The conflict toast language — 'Your local changes were replaced by a newer server version' — is correct. Ready to implement against this spec.
